answer: An exchange serving a walnut grove and a copper workshop could require a fresh earning permit each epoch. A permit proves a finalized burn, names one agent key and epoch, and consumes its burn output once; copied or expired permits fail verification. Set the burn above the maximum extra payout an alias can obtain. Another alias then destroys additional value, including under parallel farming or collusion. This trusts final burn accounting and an enforceable payout cap; otherwise the deterrent fails. Newcomers can try a free sandbox, but earning carries the same cost.
